source: delivered sputter_struct_v1 toolkit (research code, packaged with its two network checkpoints)
bundled: Import closure of scripts/sputter_struct_v1.py for analyze, table, select, sequence and physical: 38 modules of sputtergisaxs/ (including the 9-module chain scenario_ts needs for TS windows) plus the new sputter_physical.py and sputter_literature.py; experts/{polymer,TS}/model/best.pt and policy.json; configs/sputter_struct_reliability_v1.json, configs/sputter_selector_v1.json and the new configs/literature_reference_v1.json.
not_bundled: configs/ other than the three above, scan manifest
scripts/refine_polymer_review_v1.py (GPU physical refinement) and the simulation-test scripts
all other sputtergisaxs modules (not imported by the subcommands)
unresolved_local_imports: linecut_v3.analyze_frame/analyze_scan, polymer_dev_v0.infer/refinement_task/run, prediction (reference_changes), stage5_input.model_input import modules that are not bundled; none of them is called by the subcommands.

local_patches.change: policy.json reduced to the keys that define the network input (module, horizontal, vertical, direct_features, normalization, highq_only, common_signal_indices) plus D_window_ratio=null; NRExpert checks policy_transform_sha() of the shipped file against the value expected for the original policy SHA-256 the checkpoint records (check_policy), instead of the SHA-256 of the whole file.
local_patches.reason: The original policy files carried training-run paths, dataset names and domain statistics of private data; the network input transform is unchanged (same transform hash).

local_patches.change: Damaged CBF frames: CBFDamagedError, a header-only payload check before decoding (the header is read up to the binary marker, any length), shape checks in the fallback decoder; the intake leaves such a frame out explicitly (excluded_frames.json, analysed_frames / excluded_frames / frame_denominator in run.json, INTAKE_EXCLUDED progress line), readers accept the analysed count; INTAKE_PLAN <chunks> <frames> before the chunks.
local_patches.reason: A truncated frame crashed the whole intake (numpy broadcast error in the fallback decoder).

local_patches.change: The fixed detector support window is written as offsets from the beam centre (SUPPORT_ROWS_FROM_BEAM, SUPPORT_COLS_FROM_BEAM); the per-run difference-from-reference-centre metadata and dataset labels in metadata strings were removed.
local_patches.reason: No instrument values of private data in public code; results unchanged except possibly a 1-pixel difference of the window edge when a beam coordinate falls exactly on a half pixel.

local_patches.change: Both networks run on every window; binned/frames_alt.csv holds the modes of the network the stage rule did not choose (infer_alternate adds it to an older folder). frames.csv is unchanged.
local_patches.reason: The physical path can assign a window to the other network and must use that network's values.

local_patches.change: Windows with stage_unresolved (or no stage) cast no rule vote (rule_module returns None); the sequence summary names the protocol 'sputter_sequence_v1+unresolved_neutral (amendment not re-scored in simulation)' and the docstring and the help of the sequence command say so.
local_patches.reason: They voted for the island network and suppressed the film on the time-consistent path (seen on real scans); the amended path was not re-scored in the protocol's simulation test.

local_patches.change: New physical path: monotone stage path (unresolved windows imputed and marked stage_imputed, windows with < 1000 counts left without stage or values), one network per window, island values only where the path stage is islands, local log-linear (Theil-Sen) R/D trends, intensity modulation (rotation) period from the shortest repeated autocorrelation maximum, island-volume equivalent thickness, nominal thickness from a deposition rate, TS onset with its interval and the 'no TS' alternative, reversal counts per window and on the trends; structure_physical.csv and structure_physical_summary.json written by analyze and table, new subcommand physical, options --rate-nm-s and --t0-s.
local_patches.reason: Results must not switch back and forth between windows; thickness substitutes with honest scope.

local_patches.change: The Cu note reads 'Cu approximated with the Ag model, for reference only (errors not validated)'.
local_patches.reason: Clear labelling of the Cu approximation.

local_patches.change: Dataset labels, private paths, computer names and example geometry values of private data removed from configs, docstrings and help texts (reliability source and Cu condition, selector training-set path).
local_patches.reason: Nothing committed to the public repository names user data.

local_patches.change: numpy>=1.24,<3 and torch>=2.3 (first PyTorch built for NumPy 2); xraydb optional. README rewritten for the bundle, without the example scans.
local_patches.reason: NumPy 2 verified; xraydb is not used by the subcommands; the examples are private data.

local_patches.change: Literature method and comparison with published growth, called by the physical builder (analyze, table, physical) when a deposition rate is given: delta_nm = rate*(t - t0); D_lit_nm = 2*pi/q* of the direct peak (host peaks, jumps, outliers and late peaks marked in lit_status and not used; the late peaks compared with the end of the trend); D_lit_trend_nm (non-decreasing L1 fit); R_lit_nm = (delta*D^2/2.418)^(1/3), two_R_over_D_lit, coverage_lit and their trends; the network's two_R_over_D_net, coverage_net and eta_net = t_eq/delta; percolation where the trend of 2R/D reaches 1 after nucleation, with a 68 % interval over a moving-block bootstrap and the errors of the rate and t0 (--rate-error, --t0-error; state reached / first_window / not_determined / not_reached), after which R_lit is not given and D_lit (2*pi/q*) stays; checks (D monotone, percolation and TS onset against the published band of the metal and host with each value's printed or a 10 % tolerance, for Cu also with f = 2.75, network 2R/D with its coverage, network mass balance, TS film thickness: not testable while not identifiable) in structure_physical_summary.json under 'literature'. Published values with citation, DOI and provenance in configs/literature_reference_v1.json. The notes of sputter_physical are made from named templates (NOTE_TEMPLATES; same wording, numbers formatted before filling); the TS network's film thickness and metal fraction reach the film-thickness check; --polymer-type for physical and table (default: the polymer named in binned/frames.csv).
local_patches.reason: Results comparable with the published P03 analyses (same definitions), an honest comparison with published growth, and notes a program can translate.

local_patches.change: Optional end of the deposition, --t-end-s for analyze, table and physical: nominal_thickness_nm = rate*clip(t - t0, 0, t_end - t0), and the literature method uses the same delta = rate*(min(t, t_end) - t0) (constant after t_end; jumps, the percolation, its interval and the TS-onset check in the deposition time min(t, t_end)); t_end must be after t0. The summary records t_end_s and t_end_given (thickness and literature) with a note from new templates (T_END_NOTE, T_END_ASSUMED_NOTE, NOTE_T_END; NOTE_T_END_AFTER when no window comes after t_end). The command line refuses a rate that is not positive or a t_end not after t0 before any frame is read (analyze, table, physical). The literature summary no longer writes default_ready (GIMaP shows the physical path first and offers the literature method as a check).
local_patches.reason: The shutter is closed by hand: a scan can go on after the deposition (e.g. half of the scan), and rate*(t - t0) would keep growing there.
